visual_enhancers.background_texture: Subtle CSS grid texture. Add a fixed div with background-image: radial-gradient(#27272a 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px; opacity: 0.3; pointer-events: none;
visual_enhancers.shadows: Glow effect for primary actions: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(198,242,78,0.3)]
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-800 for cards, inputs, and unselected options.

participant_screens.strategy: Mobile-first (~360–430px) optimized. Use max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative to create an app-like frame.
participant_screens.spacing: Generous vertical padding. p-6 or p-8 for main containers.
participant_screens.header: Minimal absolute/fixed header. 'MEP QUIZ' wordmark (top-left) in Outfit font + 'LIVE' pill (top-right, bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold).

admin_dashboard.strategy: Desktop-only. High-density data layout. Minimalist Sidebar.
admin_dashboard.grid: Bento-style or strict table layout. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 for stat cards.
admin_dashboard.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces, NO glassmorphism for data tables to ensure maximum legibility.

motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-out for hover states and option selections.
motion.page_load: Fade in and slight slide up (translate-y-4 to 0, opacity 0 to 1) for form cards and quiz questions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #09090b and black text on #C6F24E meet WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a focus state, ideally a ring using the primary lime color.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid attributes to all inputs, buttons, and quiz options.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind configured strictly for dark mode. Set body bg to #09090b and text to white.
Import Google Fonts 'Outfit' (headings) and 'DM Sans' (body) in your CSS/HTML.
Implement the background grid texture as a fixed overlay behind the main content.
For the participant screens (Registration, Quiz, Completion), lock the max-width to 430px (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto) to mimic the mobile app feel on web.
Registration screen: Map strictly to user fields (Name, Email, Phone required, School optional). Use the specific uppercase muted labels and dark rounded inputs.
Quiz screen: Header needs 'QUESTION X OF 20', right aligned percentage. Question card with category chip. Options A/B/C/D. Timer top-right.
Admin dashboard: Build a responsive desktop layout using Shadcn UI components. Ensure tables are sortable/searchable. Include CSV export functionality.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on ALL interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. DO NOT create a generic light-mode SaaS look. Stick STRICTLY to the dark neon/tactical aesthetic.
Never center align the entire app container text. Left-align inputs, labels, and paragraph text.
Never use AI emoji characters for icons. Use 'lucide-react' icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use generous padding in cards and between sections.
Include micro-animations for hover states and selection.
Make sure error boundaries and loading states are themed properly (lime spinners, minimal text).
